# Transcription

## Page 1

**Northbridge Lettings**
**Checkout inspection report**

Records the checkout condition and cleanliness of Flat 2, 172 Alder Lane, Bellmere, ZZ3 1ZZ, including defects and photographs. The report provides the basis for the cleaning request covering vacuuming and light cleaning of the living space and limescale removal in the en-suite.

Report title: Check Out. Appointment date: 23 June 2026. Assessor: Northbridge Lettings.

The report describes the property room by room and records condition, cleanliness, defects and photographs. It states that an element or item without an assessor comment is taken to be in good, clean, serviceable condition and without defects.

The report is based on a visual inspection. Inaccessible and loft areas are not inspected. Fixtures and fittings may be listed without testing their working condition. The report does not necessarily identify structural defects or advise on repairs or their costs.

Guidance notes state that the property and contents are expected to be left in a similar condition and state of cleanliness to the report prepared before the tenancy. Cleaning should be thorough and the property left tidy.

The report says that smoke and carbon monoxide alarms will have been checked and will be in working order as of the report date; tenants are responsible for keeping them in working order and reporting faults other than battery replacement.

Checklist: no entries shown. Notes: no comments shown. Keys: no details or comments shown. External areas: Not applicable.

Assessor declaration: "I confirm that this report reflects my assessment of the property." Signature received: 24 October 2025, 11:01:09.
